Accept, reject or request a resubmission. A reason is required to reject, to request
a resubmission, and to accept a document that needs manual review (overriding a flag).

The field schema of the document type, what the station read (normalized, with
confidence) and the reviewed set if one was saved. `doc_type` previews another type's
schema (for documents the station could not classify).

put.description: Save the reviewed field set (validated). The station's own reading is kept as it was.

get.description:
Existing students that may be the person on this document (LRN first, then name +
birth date). Suggestions only: staff confirm a link.

post.description:
Staff confirm which existing student this document belongs to. Linking to a student who
is not a strong match (or not suggested at all) needs a reason.

Create a student profile from the reviewed fields (same rules as the master list) and
link the document to it.
Undo a wrong link (with a reason). The student profile itself is not changed.

post.description:
The operator closes the stack (e.g. the station stopped without ending it). The
station's next page for this batch gets 409 and it starts a new batch. Ending twice is
harmless.

ClientStatus.title: ClientStatus
ClientStatus.description:
What students see (Updated Features II-B): Pending / Approved / Rejected / Completed,
plus the end states that exist in the lifecycle.

CreateStudentIn.title: CreateStudentIn
CreateStudentIn.description:
What the document doesn't say. Names, sex, birth date and place, parents and LRN come
from the reviewed fields, never from this body.

IntakeStatus.title: IntakeStatus
IntakeStatus.description:
Processing status. screened -> accepted -> data_reviewed -> linked (S-06/S-07).

A document that passed screening may go straight from screened to data_reviewed: saving its
reviewed fields accepts it (audited as an acceptance). Rejected and resubmission-requested
documents never reach data_reviewed or linked.

RequestStatus.title: RequestStatus
RequestStatus.description:
Section 14 request lifecycle, approve-first order (change S-11).

The registrar approves the request before records are retrieved and the document is
generated, then verifies the generated document before it is released. Stored by NAME
(native_enum=False); migration e7b2c4d9a1f3 mapped the old generate-first states.

RoutedIn.title: RoutedIn
RoutedIn.description: What the gate actually did. `jam` (or no tray) = the page did not reach a tray.

StudentUpdateIn.title: StudentUpdateIn
